overview: Based on the published agenda, the Village of Kronenwetter Plan Commission was scheduled to meet to discuss several land use and zoning matters, including a Twin Home Zero Lot Line Ordinance, a Conditional Use Permit for Knetter Pond, a Marathon County Garage Site Plan, and a Septic Tank Ordinance. The meeting was also set to review the Land Use and Zoning Appeals Process and consider future review of the village's zoning and subdivisions codes.

discussions.item: Twin Home Zero Lot Line Ordinance
discussions.body: The Plan Commission was scheduled to discuss and take possible action on a Twin Home Zero Lot Line Ordinance. This item was listed under old business, suggesting it may have been carried over from a previous meeting for further consideration.
The Commission was set to discuss and consider possible action on a Conditional Use Permit related to Knetter Pond. This matter was scheduled as old business for the meeting.
The Plan Commission was expected to review and discuss a site plan for a Marathon County Garage facility. This item was listed as new business scheduled for discussion and possible action.
The Commission was set to discuss and consider possible action on a Septic Tank Ordinance. This new business item was scheduled for the meeting agenda.

discussions.item: Land Use and Zoning Appeals Process
discussions.body: The Plan Commission was scheduled to review the Land Use and Zoning Appeals Process. This item was set for discussion and possible action as new business.

discussions.item: Future Review of Zoning and Subdivisions Codes
discussions.body: The Commission was expected to consider scheduling a future review of the village's Zoning and Subdivisions Codes. This item was listed as new business for discussion and possible action.

publicComment: Public comment was indicated on the agenda, limited to 15 minutes total with a three-minute time period per person, per Wisconsin State Statute Section 19.84(2).
